VR.title: Meta is Spinning out ‘Supernatural’ a Mere 3 Years After $400M Acquisition

VR.title: CleanSheet Soccer 2 Heads To PlayStation VR2 Next Week
VR.summary: CleanSheet Soccer 2 launches on PlayStation VR2 next week, offering a redesigned experience without the subscription fees of its predecessor.
